title: 游戏进程缓慢且缺乏意义
description: 游戏进程缓慢，缺乏明确的进展感和目标，线性进程、低风险、低收益和重复性升级使游戏体验单调。
evidence: It's not a sandbox game, it has a very linear progression system that every player will share, anyone who plays the game will have generally the exact same experience and the exact same story of their gameplay.
do cargo logistics between the main station and the dummy stations, but it's not clear why: the profit, after fuel costs, is less than taking corpse inspection jobs.
very little progression/objective at the moment, but I'm sure it will be corrected.

evidence_items.quote: It's not a sandbox game, it has a very linear progression system that every player will share, anyone who plays the game will have generally the exact same experience and the exact same story of their gameplay.
evidence_items.description: 线性进程系统，所有玩家体验相同
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这不是一款沙盒游戏，它有一个非常线性的 progression 系统，每个玩家都会共享，任何玩这款游戏的人都会有大致完全相同的体验，以及完全相同的游戏过程故事。

evidence_items.quote: everything you do takes a hell of a lot of time with not much reward
evidence_items.description: 做任何事情都耗时很长但回报很少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你做的每件事都要花掉他妈的一大堆时间，却没什么回报

evidence_items.quote: Overall game progression feels grindy and tedious, while also being rather straightforward and linear.
evidence_items.description: 游戏进程感觉枯燥、繁琐且线性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 整体游戏进程感觉既肝又乏味，同时还相当直白和线性。

evidence_items.quote: The difference between "space hobo" and "actually pretty well off" is minimal, as itemization usually boils down to "you have nothing" or "you have the best tool in the game because there's only one"
evidence_items.description: 物品化导致进度差异极小，只有无物品或最佳物品
evidence_items.quote_zh: “太空流浪汉”和“其实过得相当不错”之间的差别微乎其微，因为物品化通常归结为“你一无所有”或者“你拥有游戏里最好的工具，因为只有这一个”

evidence_items.quote: it takes me hours to make small progress
evidence_items.description: 需要数小时才能取得微小进展
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我要花好几个小时才能取得一点点进展

evidence_items.quote: do cargo logistics between the main station and the dummy stations, but it's not clear why: the profit, after fuel costs, is less than taking corpse inspection jobs.
evidence_items.description: 货物物流收益扣除燃料后低于检查尸体任务，缺乏意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在主站和假站之间做货物物流，但不清楚为什么：扣除燃料成本后的利润，比接尸体检查任务还少。

evidence_items.quote: The restoration and repair of components has the highest grind level in the game, you will spend hours and hours at this task.
evidence_items.description: 组件修复需要花费大量时间，即使加速也需数小时
evidence_items.quote_zh: 部件的修复和维修是游戏里肝度最高的部分，你会在这项任务上花上好几个小时。

evidence_items.quote: До контента все так же трудно хоть как-то добраться. Потратив 6 часов в новой версии, все что я опять же смог ощутить это однобразный гринд.
evidence_items.description: 很难接触到内容，需要大量重复劳动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 要接触到内容依然还是那么困难，无论如何都很难到达。在新版本里花了6个小时，我再次能感受到的只有单调乏味的刷。

evidence_items.quote:
this is too slow for me.

Maybe it speeds up with getting a bigger ship and more crew. But I never got there even with one playthrough going 12 hours.
evidence_items.description: 游戏进程太慢，即使游玩12小时也未获得更大飞船或更多船员
evidence_items.quote_zh:
这对我来说太慢了。

也许随着获得更大的飞船和更多船员会加快速度。但即使有一次游玩了12个小时，我也从未达到那一步。

evidence_items.quote: Lack of progression.  Want to upgrade your ship?  It's more of the same ♥♥♥♥ your ship has.  You're never getting meaningful upgrades just more of the same stuff you already have.
evidence_items.description: 飞船升级没有意义，只是重复已有内容。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 缺乏进展。想升级你的飞船？那不过是你飞船已有的那些♥♥♥♥的更多重复。你永远得不到有意义的升级，只是你已经拥有的那些东西的更多重复。

evidence_items.quote: you are only ever going to earn $20,000 - $80,000 for the big items you take off the derelicts
evidence_items.description: 打捞大件物品收入低且耗时极长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你从废弃船只上拆下来的大件物品，最多也只能卖到 20,000 到 80,000 美元

evidence_items.quote: when they finally reach 100% you never get anything for it
evidence_items.description: 技能达到100%后没有任何奖励
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当他们终于达到100%时，你却什么也得不到

evidence_items.quote: after you get about 30k (which happens quickly if you know what your doing), game doesn't feel high stakes or desperate. Your financial comfort makes scavenging less compelling
evidence_items.description: 赚到约3万后游戏缺乏高风险或绝望感，拾荒动力下降
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当你赚到大约3万之后（如果你知道自己在做什么，这很快就会发生），游戏就不再让人感到高风险或绝望了。你的财务宽裕让拾荒变得不那么有吸引力了

evidence_items.quote: very little progression/objective at the moment, but I'm sure it will be corrected.
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前进展/目标非常少，但我相信这会被修正。
